Noah Wyle and 'The Pitt' Win Emmy Awards

Noah Wyle won an Emmy Award for best actor in a drama series for his role in 'The Pitt', marking his second win. The series 'The Pitt' also secured an Emmy for best drama series for the second consecutive year. Rhea Seehorn received an award and became emotional during her acceptance speech.
